nodes.name: List Live Client Companies
nodes.notes: MOVED from Opportunities to Companies this pass (object model migration, CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md) - this was the concrete bug the v4 comparison surfaced: 'Live Client' is a post-sale state, and post-sale automations (health/usage scoring, tier upgrade, referral, churn) operate on the Company that now represents the ongoing client relationship, not the Opportunity that was the pre-sale funnel object. Querying Opportunities filtered to a stage that Opportunities no longer even reach (W1.6 now advances Opportunities to 'Won', not 'LiveClient') would have returned nothing, silently. UNVERIFIED: the filter query string syntax, same Twenty CRM REST-shape uncertainty as every workflow here. Assumes every Company carries the liveClientSince timestamp W1.6's 'Create Company' node now sets, and an engagementScore field (written by W4.1's health/usage scoring, not built) - if engagementScore doesn't exist yet, this workflow has nothing real to filter on and will need adjusting once W4.1 exists.

nodes.name: Flag referral-eligible on Company
nodes.notes: Auto-flags eligibility (internal, reversible) - per the automation risk boundary, actually ASKING the client for a referral is an external send and stays human-gated, which is why this workflow stops at flagging + alerting a rep, not drafting/sending anything itself. Writes to Company now, matching the query above.

nodes.name: Alert rep

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'referral-trigger', message: $json.companyName + ' is now referral-eligible (' + $json.tenureDays + ' days tenure, engagement ' + $json.engagementScore + ') - reach out to ask.' }) }}
